name: PR Files changed tab groups files by role (Smart Diff, M3)
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab: the Smart order shows the Core group (all 4 seeded files are src/** → core) with its file count, and the Original order switch brings back the flat GitHub list. Read-only seeded data, no model call (GET /pulls/:id/smart-diff never calls an LLM). Waits avoid the uppercase 'Reviewer-ordered diff' title because agent-browser matches innerText (see e2e/INSIGHTS.md). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
switch to the Files changed tab
diff tab is active in the URL
the Smart / Original order switch renders
the group shows its file count
switch to the original GitHub order
the flat list shows a seeded file
